data.one_liner: A customizable chat widget toolkit with message grouping and async sending.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use chat UI components including message lists, input fields, profiles, and timestamps. Supports automatic message grouping, async message dispatch with retry logic, and custom message elements.
use_when: You need to build a chat interface quickly in Flutter.
You require customizable message bubbles and context menus.
You want built-in support for message states like loading, success, and failure.
avoid_when: You need a backend chat service rather than just UI components.
Your chat requirements are extremely simple and can be done with a basic ListView.
strengths: Includes features like message grouping, retry mechanisms, and context menus out of the box.
Extensible architecture with custom message elements and builders.
weaknesses: Requires managing chat state and backend integration manually.
Limited to the provided styling paradigms unless extensively customized.
